messages:
Maria: Got a chargeback for INV-2026-0042 — $12,450. Reason: "fraudulent / cardholder did not recognize". Processor gave us 7 days to respond.
Kira: Please share dispute id and any PAN/bin info and I9ll start the evidence pack.
Maria: Dispute ID DB-9817623. BIN 4553xxxx, last4 1123. Billing addr matches account, but IP geo is different country. I attached the support convo.
Sam: Support transcript (redacted):
Customer: I did not authorize this charge on 03/11.
Support: Can you confirm last 4?
Customer: 1123.
Support: We see API activity from this org 03/10-03/11.
Sam: Partner-sales confirmed this customer had a burst of usage during that window.
Alejandro: Risk quick take: billing/geo mismatch -> medium risk; multiple API keys used in 24h -> suspicious; no prior chargebacks.
Alejandro: Evidence we should include: invoice, itemized usage CSV with req ids/timestamps, signed TOS, IP and device logs, support transcript, finance statement. Also fraud analysis note.
Kira: I9ll assemble evidence. Note: processor forbids unredacted PANs. I will redact and produce PDF/CSV files (no ZIP).
payment-webhook-bot: {"dispute_id":"DB-9817623","amount":"12450","currency":"USD","received_at":"2026-03-12T09:14:22Z","reason_code":"customer_dispute"}
Devon: Draft representment structure:
- Dispute ID / merchant ref
- Chronology of events
- Itemized usage + API request IDs (CSV)
- Supporting logs (IP/device)
- Signed TOS and refund policy
- Request to decline chargeback
Devon: Recommend temporary billing hold on the org until resolution — legal signoff?
Maria: Legal asked we preserve logs and avoid admission of liability. Hold is OK. I authorize representment once Kira confirms redactions.
Kira: Uploading individual files to S3 and will paste presigned links. Expect complete bundle by EOD.
billing-bot: Evidence uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/DB-9817623/ (private). Pre-signed links generated.
Kira: Bank requires PDFs/CSVs only. I9ll reupload items in that format and share links.
Alejandro: I9ll run the fraud score and provide a short analysis note for the packet (geo velocity, token reuse).
Sam: Support will pause outbound refund comms to the cardholder until we have outcome.
Devon: I9ll finish the representment narrative and route to Maria for signature.
Maria: Reminder — bank cutoff 2026-03-19 09:00 UTC. If we miss it they auto-win. Everyone, confirm EOD status.
Kira: On track.
Alejandro: Working it.
Devon: Draft ready for review.
Maria: Thanks team, add any receipts/ticket ids to the evidence index. :thumbsup:
payment-webhook-bot: Dispute DB-9817623 status -> awaiting_evidence at 2026-03-12T12:02:03Z
